overview.text: Indian Overseas Bank (IOB) is issuing a Request for Proposal to select Stand-Alone Health Insurance providers for a Corporate Agency Arrangement to offer health insurance products to its customers. The arrangement involves a minimum commitment period of three years, subject to satisfactory performance and potential renewal.

scope.text: The successful bidder must provide operational support for sales, training, renewals, claim settlement, and grievance redressal to IOB customers.
Services include providing full range of health insurance products (individual and group) via bank channels, real-time data sharing, and MIS updates.
Bidder must ensure claims are settled within IRDAI prescribed timelines and maintain a minimum Claim Settlement Ratio of 90%.
Scope includes providing robust IT systems, digital infrastructure capable of integrating with the Bank's Core Banking Solution, and dedicated portal access.
Bidder must provide manpower support, training to Bank staff, and ensure uninterrupted service with sole responsibility on the Company side.
Bidder must comply with regulatory guidelines from IRDAI and RBI regarding Unfair Trade Practices, Mis-selling, and Anti-Consumer Policies.

key_requirements.text: Bidders must submit a duly signed Integrity Pact along with the bid; failure or violation results in disqualification.
Bidder must execute an agreement containing terms including indemnity and non-disclosure clauses upon selection.
Bidder must disclose any transgressions with public/government organizations within the last three years preceding bid submission.
Bidder must have a Code of Conduct clearly rejecting the use of bribes and other unethical behavior with a compliance program for implementation throughout the company.
Bidder must submit proposals as per broad specifications listed in the invitation document, including business strategy and revenue estimates for the next 3 years.
Bidder must commit to providing MIS support and remit revenue/commission payable to the Bank every month at the corporate level.

eligibility.text: Bidder must be a Stand-Alone Health Insurance company licensed or registered with the IRDAI.
Bidder should be technologically enabled to provide robust IT systems for sharing and exchanging data with the bank on a real-time basis.
The Bank reserves the right to reject any or all offers based on its own evaluation of suitability, capabilities, track records, reputation among users, and other similar credentials.
Bidders must observe the highest standard of ethics and avoid corrupt practices such as offering, giving, receiving, or soliciting anything of value to influence officials.
The Bank may disqualify bidders who violate the provisions of the Integrity Pact at any stage of the bidding process.

important_dates.text: Last Date and Time for receipt of Proposals: 08.06.2026 upto 5.00 PM
Date and Time of Opening of Proposals: 10.06.2026, 11.00 AM
Date of Presentation of shortlisted bidders: 17.06.2026
All proposals shall be valid for a period of 180 days from the last date of submission.

commercial_requirements.text: The successful bidder should remit the revenue/commission payable to the bank by the 10th working day of every month at the corporate level with complete details.
Any expenditure towards integration of APIs, technology or system synchronization etc shall be borne by the successful bidder, as and when required.
All cost and expenses incurred by Applicants in any way associated with the development, preparation and submission of proposal will be borne entirely and exclusively by the Applicants.
Bidders will have to make their travel and stay arrangements at their own cost. Bank will not bear any kind of cost for the same.
Bank reserves the right to negotiate with L1 insurance company on pricing/commission after allotment of tender anytime during the tenure of the agreement.

project_duration.text: This arrangement will be initially for a period of 3 years subject to satisfactory performance and annual review.
Bank at its sole discretion may renew the arrangement for a further period of 3 years on mutually agreed terms.

The tie up between the selected Company and the Bank shall be for a minimum period of 3 years subject to termination, commencing from a date to be determined/advised after completion of the process of selection.
The arrangement may renew thereafter at the discretion of the Bank, subject to satisfactory performance.

The tie-up between the selected Company and the Bank shall be for a minimum period of 3 years, subject to termination, commencing from a date to be determined /advised after completion of the process of selection.
Bank at its sole discretion may renew the arrangement for a further period of 3 years or on mutually agreed terms subject to regulatory guidelines or discontinue this arrangement.

The validity of this Integrity Pact shall extend up to 5 years or the complete execution of the contract to the satisfaction of both the Bank and the Bidder, including warranty period, whichever is later.

important_conditions.text: Confidentiality and non-disclosure obligations apply; customer data must be kept secret and not used for any purpose other than rendering services to policyholders and the Bank.
No part of services can be sub-contracted without prior written consent of the Bank.
The selected Bidder shall not terminate the agreement for convenience; termination would be in accordance with IRDAI Regulations or by issue of notice without assigning reason.
Any suspected or confirmed Data Breach must be notified to the Bank immediately; suspected breaches must be reported within 4 hours of discovery.
The signing of this Integrity Pact is a preliminary qualification to participate in the aforementioned bidding process.
